name: Antarctic Expedition
source:
The Antarctic Expedition follows the story of a human Artificer novice from the west, who was sent to explore the cold south as a trial before he can earn his full rank. Many people were sent before him, but very few return. The Artificer's worst fears are realized when he runs into a horrifying and dangerous lynx on his expedition, but fate seems to draw them together. 

[From [url=https://snoopydoo123.itch.io/antarctic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《南极探险》讲述了一位来自西方的人类技师新手的故事，他被派去探索寒冷的南方，作为他获得满级之前的考验。在他之前被派去的人很多，但回来的人却很少。当技师在探险中遇到一只可怕而危险的山猫时，他最担心的事情就实现了，但命运似乎将他们吸引到了一起。

[来自[url=https://snoopydoo123.itch.io/antarctic]Itch.io[/url]]
